lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: Door's open. So is the cell.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: Gantt wrote three towns and one sentence: somebody is being paid. I've a deputy who irons his star and a hand that won't hold a cup. So. Spike, scoop or tag. Pick one up off my desk.

buttons.label: The spike. I'll take the rail.
The scoop. I'll go by river.
The tag. I'll walk the pike.
Call the fair without my report.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: There is still a road open if you want it. Or tell me what you've learned. No need to promise a journey just to ask a question.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: Iron Junction. Ask for Gussie Lockridge and don't let her feed you. She's lost four trains and blames the weather, and Gussie has never been wrong about weather in her life.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: Greenwater. The woman with the ladle is Opal Starnes. Do what she says until you understand why, and after that use your own judgment. There's a boy with a skiff at the landing.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: Red Hollow, by the pike. You'll pass Brigg's gate at the gap. Ask what evidence Esther Quill has heard before you pay for a pardon. A bench on a wagon isn't proof of a fair hearing.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: In 2298 I hanged an innocent man. Quill had the counter-evidence before the drop. I checked too late. Take my review copy if you mean to ask for a hearing. It doesn't prove the man on her wagon innocent.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: Then we hear what the flags have to offer. Talbot will post the notice. The roads are still there if you change your mind; I won't call a refusal a promise.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: Sawtooth Cut. I had it from the yard hands before you'd your boots off, in four versions, and you were nine feet tall in one. Tell me the part they don't know.

buttons.label: Silver. With a square stamped on it.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: Sawtooth Cut. I had it from the yard hands before you'd your boots off, in four versions, and you were nine feet tall in one. Tell me the part they don't know.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: Greenwater. I can smell the lake on you. Opal Starnes sent a boy to say you'd been, and nothing else, which from Opal is a sermon. What was Lyle Hatcher doing with a town's corn?

buttons.label: He was paid to hold it. In silver.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: Red Hollow. You've the clay on you to the knee. I'm told the hill moved, or didn't, depending who's telling. Sit. What did Hobart Blevins chain that mine against?

buttons.label: He was paid to. In silver.

lines.speaker: pritchard

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: Gantt suspected a common purse. One road isn't the whole account. Decoration Day's in a week. I'll ask every flag in these valleys to eat my chicken and answer questions where the town can hear.

lines.speaker: talbot
lines.text: Gate's open till dark. Weapons stay holstered inside. That's the sheriff's rule, I mean. Not mine. Well, mine too.

lines.speaker: talbot
lines.text: You're going out? On your own? He's never sent me past the creek. ...If you get to the Junction and see Billie Tupper, don't say I asked after her. But I'm asking.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: You have a rail-payment lead. Tell me how you learned it. If you travelled the line, separate what you saw from what somebody told you.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: If you haven't taken the rail, ask about Iron Junction. If you have, tell me what you saw. Don't name a payer unless you've learned who paid.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: You have a hire-payment lead for Greenwater. Tell me its source. Going there isn't the only way to hear a claim, and hearing one doesn't prove it.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: If you haven't been to Greenwater, ask me the way. If you have, tell me what became of the grain and how you learned it.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: You have a payment lead about Red Hollow. Say how you learned it. If you've been to the Mouth, tell me that account separately.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: If Red Hollow is still ahead of you, ask me the way. If you've been, tell me what happened at the Mouth. Leave the payment column blank unless you've learned it.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: Which road's account do you want to discuss? The fair hasn't made the facts less important.
